'''Chroma-neekas''' were tiny [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]-like creatures that nested inside [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and other electric devices. The fed off the power lines causing malfunctions. Chroma-neeka's would spread by stowing away aboard [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]].

In [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] jargon, a chroma-neeka was someone who used the complicated layers of governmental and corporate [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] to their own advantage.
